title: storefront.enquiry.created
description: A buyer sent an enquiry from a published store. This is the product's order equivalent: there is no cart and no checkout. `company` is the buyer's own business name. The buyer's email and phone are sealed PII and never travel on this event. `lines` carries the catalogue product and quantity for each line, with the product name as it was when the enquiry was sent. The payload carries no `organization_id`; the envelope's is authoritative.
$comment: Ahead of the producer (ADR-0020 slice I7): services/storefront/app/services.py:create_enquiry_for_store does not emit status, lines yet. Until that slice merges, a real payload fails this schema on exactly those fields. That is the forcing function, not a bug. Every other field is emitted today.
